name: Narrm Scholarship (University of Melbourne)
summary: A $6,500 yearly living allowance for Access Melbourne undergraduates, plus relocation and accommodation allowances for some.
key: $6,500 a year for four years, up to $35,500, plus a $3,000 relocation allowance for regional or remote students.
who: Australian or NZ citizen or Australian permanent visa holder.
Completed Year 12 or IB in Australia and meets Access Melbourne entry requirements.
how: You're considered automatically if you apply for admission and submit a VTAC Equity Schemes and scholarships application.
catches: Offers are made after Victorian ATARs are released in December.
A limited number of $20,000-a-year accommodation allowances are also offered.

evidence.quote: A living allowance of $6500 per year for four years paid in half-yearly instalments of $3250 in April and September
You are automatically considered if you have applied for admission to the University
